LOOTCOON (LOOTC)

More Than a Token. A Royal Global Community. A Lasting Legacy.

An Official Introduction and a Personal Message from the Founder

LOOTCOON (LOOTC) is an independent, community-driven meme cryptocurrency launched on October 6, 2026, through PumpFun on the Sol-blockchain.

Represented by its iconic royal crowned raccoon, LOOTCOON was created to become far more than a digital token or a temporary market trend. It is an ambitious creative and entertainment-driven project founded upon a powerful vision: to unite people from different countries, cultures, languages, and backgrounds under one shared identity, one global family, and one enduring dream.

At the heart of this vision stands the Royal Global LOOTCOON Family, proudly known as the Royal LOOTCOON Tribe — a worldwide community of real people connected not by geography, nationality, or social status, but by creativity, mutual respect, compassion, unity, and a genuine sense of belonging.

LOOTCOON brings its identity to life through original cinematic storytelling, imaginative fictional adventures, animated entertainment, digital creativity, and meaningful community engagement. Its royal crowned raccoon is the distinguished symbol of the project, representing determination, confidence, resilience, compassion, courage, and the aspiration to rise above limitations.

Our philosophy is built upon authenticity, transparent communication, responsible development, and natural community growth. We reject artificial hype, misleading promises, and manipulative pump&dump practices. We believe that a project's reputation must be earned through consistent dedication, honest participation, and the trust of its community.

Although LOOTCOON began as a meme cryptocurrency, its ambition extends far beyond that category. Our long-term vision is to develop a globally recognized brand, expand a distinctive cinematic and creative universe, encourage meaningful collaborations, and establish a peaceful, inclusive, and enduring community identity.

We do not measure our dream in days, months, or years. We envision LOOTCOON as a lifelong commitment and a legacy capable of continuing beyond the lifetime of its founder.

The greatest achievement of a founder is not to make a project permanently dependent upon his presence, but to create something meaningful enough for its community to embrace, protect, develop, and carry forward into the future.

LOOTCOON was founded by one individual, but its future belongs to the entire community.

The Dream Shared by the Founder and LOOTCOON

Long before LOOTCOON was officially launched on Pump/Fun, I carried a dream that lived in my heart every single day.

I dreamed of the moment when our royal crowned raccoon would proudly appear on the globally recognized DexScreener platform, accompanied by its official identity, its story, and the links connecting our growing worldwide community.

That dream existed before LOOTCOON entered the market. It continued after the launch, without interruption, until this very moment-the moment we are taking a meaningful step to present LOOTCOON's official identity on DexScreener.

In a deeply personal way, the founder and his creation have always shared the same dream.

Day after day, I imagined LOOTCOON asking alongside me:

“When will our moment finally arrive? When will the world see our royal crowned raccoon proudly displayed on the global DexScreener platform?”

And today, as we submit our project's information for your consideration, I feel that we have reached a significant moment in this extraordinary journey.

What once existed only as a dream is now becoming a tangible step toward the future we have imagined together.

To me, DexScreener is far more than a cryptocurrency market analytics platform.

It is one of the world's most recognized and influential gateways to decentralized project discovery-a powerful, direct, accessible, and internationally respected connection between emerging projects and the global communities seeking to discover them.

For creators, investors, and independent project founders, DexScreener provides something of exceptional value: the opportunity for the world to discover their projects.

Its global reach, accessibility, established reputation, and widely used analytical tools make it one of the most effective platforms for presenting a project's identity to an international audience.

In my eyes, DexScreener is not merely another milestone along a project's journey. It is one of the clearest, strongest, and most direct pathways through which a small idea can begin reaching communities far beyond the place where it was born.

And that is precisely what I dream of for LOOTCOON.

I dream of people discovering our royal crowned raccoon across different countries, speaking different languages, and belonging to communities separated by geography, yet discovering a shared sense of connection through our story.

I dream of those distant and diverse communities gradually coming together as one royal global family:

The Royal LOOTCOON Tribe.

A peaceful and welcoming community without borders, where differences become strengths, creativity brings people together, and mutual respect gives everyone a place to belong.

I do not dream of creating a token that exists for one day, one month, or even one year.

I dream of building something that continues throughout my lifetime-and, when my own journey eventually comes to an end, continues through the people who believe in it and choose to carry its vision forward.

One day, I may no longer be here to lead, write, create, or tell LOOTCOON's stories.

But my greatest hope is that those stories will continue, that the royal crowned raccoon will remain a symbol of unity and compassion, and that the community will continue building what we began together.

That is the legacy I aspire to leave behind.

Not merely a cryptocurrency.

Not merely a recognizable logo.

But a living global community, a meaningful identity, and a dream passed from one generation of supporters to the next.

To the distinguished DexScreener team, I extend my deepest appreciation and sincere respect.

Your platform has become an essential destination through which decentralized projects are discovered, explored, and followed by communities around the world. For independent founders like me, its reach, accessibility, and international reputation represent an extraordinary opportunity to introduce an authentic project to a wider global audience.

I hold great respect for the important role your team plays in this ecosystem, and I sincerely appreciate the opportunity to present LOOTCOON's official identity for your review.

Seeing our official royal crowned raccoon logo, project description, and community links displayed on DexScreener would mean far more to me than a technical update.

It would represent the realization of a dream that LOOTCOON and I have carried together every single day-before its launch, throughout its journey, and right up to this very moment.

And as we take this step today, I hope it becomes the beginning of a remarkable new chapter for our growing worldwide family.

From one founder's dream to the shared future of a royal global community.

Different Faces. One Family. One Dream.

With profound appreciation, sincere respect, and unwavering belief in our community's future,

LOOTCOON Founder
Creator & Founder of LOOTCOON (LOOTC)

Welcome to the Royal LOOTCOON Tribe.
